summary: Your Azure resources and ServiceNow records now show owner and purpose tags inherited from higher levels.

new.title: Resources inherit tags from their parents
new.text: An Azure resource now also shows the tags of its resource group and subscription, marked with their origin. Its own tag wins, and untagged resources now get owner, application and purpose.

new.title: Tags sent to ServiceNow
new.text: The ServiceNow hand-off offers three new columns: all tags, own tags and inherited tags. ServiceNow ignores them until your ServiceNow team adds them.

new.title: Tags in rules, reports and connectors
new.text: Every tag of an asset, its own first and then the inherited ones, is now available as one field for rules, reports and connectors.

new.title: An easier CI page
new.text: Tags show their values, field names stay on one line, you can resize small table columns, and the field sources table shows each value.
